synthesis: Evidence for a second model is real but modest and mixed. Different reviewers catch partly different defects (Song 2026: 41.2% overlap; Greptile 2026), and errors are correlated across models, more so within a provider (Kim et al., ICML 2025). But the one controlled test on review found no significant F1 gain over a fresh same-model session. No peer-reviewed study of cross-model code review of agent output was found.
